title: The Atiyah conjecture on configurations on the invertibility of a certain $n$-by-$n$ matrix depending on $n$ points in $\mathbb{R}^{3}$
exact_target: Do the direction polynomials associated with any distinct points in three-dimensional space always form an invertible coefficient matrix?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 7200059 (AMR-071-0059). CC BY 4.0.
Michael Atiyah and Paul Sutcliffe, The Geometry of Point Particles (2001). Section 2, Conjecture 1, and Section 3, pp. 3–5.
